scope: Public backup implementation: API-owned snapshots, age encryption, scoped B2 transport, serial scheduling, retention and health

build.applicationBuild: passed: Yjs patch/runtime, TypeScript, Vite, 136.7 kB initial JS / 350 kB budget, built-origin scan

backupChecks: Fixed WAL read point while another connection commits; later writing remains pending for another snapshot.
Real tar/gzip/age encryption/decryption, exact membership/hashes, and tamper refusal.
UTC retention boundaries, last verified anchor preservation and clock rollback.
Scoped B2 authorization and endpoint validation; actual streamed upload to loopback protocol fixture.
Exact-version readback; lost replies and corrupt copies do not authorize pruning.
Unverified hourly/daily keepers must pass readback before displacing good alternatives.
Paginated version listing, repeated-cursor refusal, unrelated/maintenance-file preservation, permanent version deletion/retry.
No concurrent/queued cycles; unchanged source skips upload; cancellation waits for cleanup.
Real API and worker process crash/restart; fresh decrypted backup contains an accepted registration; graceful ownership release.

checks: Non-root Node 24 runtime excludes repository, tests, development state and build tools
Explicit initialization publishes a pinned identity using external secret custody
Ordinary API startup refuses an uninitialized volume
A second container cannot take ownership of the same live store
Keyless app container serves the session API through exact-origin scoped boundaries
Every packaged service-worker precache response matches its recorded bytes
SIGKILL/restart reacquires ownership and preserves identity plus the accepted registration attempt
Graceful stop exits cleanly; explicit initialization retry retains the existing identity

limits: B2 protocol fixture only: no real bucket/key, external upload or provider TLS interoperability check.
Backup tests run inside the ARM64 build as UID 65532; packaged two-container smoke has backups disabled and checks runtime packaging/restart plus the age binary.
Saved real recovery identity, provider upload/readback and backup decrypt rehearsal are required before activation.
Maintenance/migration and rollback-safe restore are not implemented by this phase.
No public deployment, retained Tailscale state change, infrastructure modification or registry push.
No host power-loss durability claim or resumed generalized release campaign.
